# Padilla Advisory Group

> Padilla Advisory Group works exclusively with longtime homeowners who are ready for
> what's next. We guide seasoned homeowners through life's biggest transitions —
> simplifying, unlocking equity, and moving forward with confidence into the next chapter.
> Based in Beverly Hills. Serving all of Los Angeles. We don't chase listings; we earn
> trust, and then we deliver.

## Advisor
Alex Padilla, Real Estate Advisor. CA DRE #01984740. Practicing at PLG Estates.

## Services
- Home Selling — Full-service from prep to close: curated vendors, staging, marketing, and negotiation, engineered for maximum value.
- Equity Analysis — Find out what your home is worth today, and what it could be worth with the right prep. No obligation, no pressure.
- Downsizing Consultation — We map out your options and build a clear, no-pressure plan on your timeline.
- Senior Transition — We guide seniors and their families through moves into care communities, with compassion, trusted resources, and zero added stress.

## Who we serve
Longtime homeowners, empty nesters, retirees, and their families in Los Angeles who are
downsizing, unlocking equity, or transitioning into senior living.

## Areas served
Based in Beverly Hills, serving all of Los Angeles — including West Hollywood, Studio City,
Sherman Oaks, Beachwood Canyon, the Hollywood Hills, Los Feliz, Silver Lake and the Eastside,
and the greater Westside.

## Free resource
The LA Downsizer's Playbook: What to Do Before You List — a free guide by Alex Padilla
covering the real annual cost of staying, Proposition 19 property-tax-base transfers,
realistic timelines, handling a lifetime of belongings, and the questions to ask any agent.
Download: https://padillaadvisorygroup.com/assets/la-downsizers-playbook.pdf
